<a id="逐除外推--extrapolation-by-elimination"></a>
# Extrapolation by elimination

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Every extrapolation has an open course on which each value it proposes misses; no prefix fixes the next value. In a world held by a list the misses are bounded, coming to rest is unrefuted and happens only there, and when does not show; learning over classes is the same learning.

`learning-by-refutation` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F11

Editable record: [learning-by-refutation.json](learning-by-refutation.json) · [Register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

A course o : Nat → O is a sequence of values (such as a determined law's orbit read through a map); prefixOf o t is its prefix before step t, latest first; an extrapolation is any map pred : List O → Option O from a prefix to a proposed value or silence; a proposed value misses (Misses) when a value is proposed and the value that comes differs; a candidate accords with a course (Accords) when it misses at no step. With no premise: for every course and step t, given two values, two courses share its prefix before t and take the one and the other value at t, and a value proposed from that prefix is not right on both (no_prefix_fixes_next), and with values decided misses on one of them (claim_missed_on_one); both are courses of worlds held by a list (holdFrom_lasso, no_prefix_fixes_next_finite). For every extrapolation and every other moving each value, the diagonal course diagonal pred other x makes each value it proposes miss (diagonal_misses), so on it the extrapolation does not, from any step on, propose at every step and be right (diagonal_unrested); it is the course of a law keeping its whole prefix, whose configurations no list holds (prefix_diagonal, diagonal_open). Extrapolation by elimination (indexOn, byElimination: candidates H in order, moving on exactly where the one held misses; values decided) never passes a candidate that accords: where H j accords the index is at most j (index_le_of_accords) and the extrapolation does not miss at arbitrarily late steps (misses_not_recurring); every candidate passed missed within the prefix at some step (missed_before); one prefix gives one candidate and one proposed value (byElimination_through_prefix). Lassos (Lasso o i q: repeating from step i with period q + 1): where a determined law's orbit is held by a list l, its course through every map is a lasso with i + q + 1 ≤ l.length (lasso_of_held); every lasso is the course through a map of a world held by a list (lasso_realized). With the lasso candidates in diagonal order (lassos, pairAt, pairAt_place): on a lasso course the extrapolation misses at most tri (i + q) + q times, proposes at every step from step i + q + 1 on and does not miss at arbitrarily late steps (lasso_byElimination_bounded), and that from some step on it proposes at every step and is right is unrefuted (rest_unrefuted, a double negation); where from some step on it proposes at every step and is right, the course is a lasso (lasso_of_rest); where the orbit is held by a list l it misses fewer than tri l.length times, proposes at every step from step l.length on and does not miss at arbitrarily late steps (held_byElimination_bounded), its coming to rest unrefuted (held_rest_unrefuted); its diagonal course is no lasso (diagonal_not_lasso); that a bounded count that never falls is constant from some step on is unrefuted (stable_unrefuted). With classes G c merged along the pairs (merged), where G c j accords the extrapolation over the merged enumeration has index at most tri (c + j) + j (merged_bound), and the extrapolation over every merging is unrested on its diagonal course (merged_unrested). Witness: on Alternate (false, true, false, …) the extrapolation misses twice and is right at every step from the third (Alternate.index_three, Alternate.rests).

Canonical source: [Learning.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Learning.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- No axiom. Decidable equality of values (DecidableEq O) appears only as a condition of the extrapolation (extrapolation by elimination, the lasso extrapolation, the merged extrapolation and diagonal_not_lasso) and of swapTo (another value), and is used only in the proofs of claim_missed_on_one and eq_of_not_missed; no_prefix_fixes_next and diagonal_misses, diagonal_unrested and diagonal_open do not use it (each is listed in the decidability inventory).
- Each theorem's conditions are written into it: two different values (no_prefix_fixes_next); other moving every value (the diagonal); some candidate according (index_le_of_accords, misses_not_recurring); the course being a lasso or the orbit held by a list (lasso_byElimination_bounded, held_byElimination_bounded). The candidates H and the classes G are supplied from outside the learning.
- Coming to rest is stated only as a double negation (rest_unrefuted, held_rest_unrefuted, stable_unrefuted), the names carrying “unrefuted” under the integrator's rule: the step of rest is not stated here (not shown impossible; P83 states it: where the orbit is held by a list of length N, the extrapolation proposes and is right at every step from N + (2N − 1)·tri N on, Identification.held_byElimination_rests, a step the bound gives and the extrapolation's prefix does not show); “not missing at arbitrarily late steps” is the negation of misses recurring, not “no miss from some step on”.

On 12 October 2026 Ren asked how completely the meta level, artificial neural networks, cognition and the wisdom about learning are explained; to the AI's answer (none complete, induction undissolved) Ren replied “please, fully complete, 我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模 finish wisdom root, and resolve the undissolved”. The AI reads it as completing the three proposed steps and resolving the problem of induction. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): induction is resolved into laws rather than certified; Hume's problem sits at no_prefix_fixes_next; extrapolation by elimination is identification in the limit in Gold's sense, its rest not showing; the meta level is learning again, with no top (the reading of merged_unrested); wisdom is never a completed extrapolation.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 75 theorems of Becoming.Learning all have empty axiom reports, among them no_prefix_fixes_next, claim_missed_on_one, diagonal_misses, diagonal_open, index_le_of_accords, misses_not_recurring, held_byElimination_bounded, held_rest_unrefuted and merged_unrested; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §92 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.

Which candidates or classes an actual formation holds, whether its values through a map can be told apart and whether its world is held by a list are not derived; the bound tri N is coarse, not optimal; only determined, value-by-value learning is stated, and probabilistic or approximate learning (PAC), the general theory of countable classes and computational complexity are not; the main theorems are known results of learning theory (Putnam's 1963 diagonal, identification in the limit after Gold 1967 and Putnam 1965, Gold's enumeration method, Kelly 1996) in the spine's form, the delta being their integration with coupling, experiment, mechanism and selection; the readings other than 理 are the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; contains no ethical predicate.

- No extrapolation rests on every course: the diagonal course makes each value it proposes miss (diagonal_unrested), and the lasso extrapolation's diagonal course is no lasso (diagonal_not_lasso). <a id="依赖与关联-dependencies-and-related-results"></a>
## Dependencies and related results

- **formal-reuse**: [recurrence-without-premise](recurrence-without-premise.md). Reuses Law.orbit, Law.process, revisits_within (within finitely many configurations the orbit returns), unlisted_of_new (a law new at every step is held by no list), gap_of_le, gap_of_lt and mem_cons_split. The delta reads return off the course through a map: the course through a map of an orbit held by a list is a lasso, and the course of a law keeping its whole prefix is the diagonal course.
- **interpretive**: [testing-within-couplings](testing-within-couplings.md). P49's Web.tail_unexcluded (without a model no finite prefix excludes a claim about what follows) is the same law for level histories; here it is stated for every course (no_prefix_fixes_next), with its positive side: in a world held by a list extrapolation by elimination misses a bounded number of times.

**Output:** Within finitely many configurations the orbit returns; a law new at every step is held by no list.

**Input:** The course through a map of a world held by a list is a lasso; the diagonal course's world is open.

**Preserved conditions:** No premise; a determined law. [Recurrence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Recurrence.lean)


**Output:** A claim is excluded only through a difference in what couples in; without a model the prefix excludes no claim about what follows.

**Input:** Misses and learning on a course.

**Preserved conditions:** Values through the map that can be told apart (for extrapolation by elimination). [Testing.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Testing.lean)

- Related, not a proved adapter: [experiment-needs-return](experiment-needs-return.md). There the record fixes an act's outcome only where taken; here the prefix fixes no next value, and a lasso's return is the return that lets learning come to rest.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [generalization-through-lumping](generalization-through-lumping.md). There, when a model of what is irrelevant is right; here, when learning that selects a model from the prefix comes to rest.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [scientific-inquiry-foundation](scientific-inquiry-foundation.md). The laws of induction are part of the necessary relations of scientific inquiry; this record does not prove the whole core indispensable to science.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [learnable-through-a-map](learnable-through-a-map.md). Where the map does not tell configurations apart: some extrapolation rests at every configuration exactly where configurations with the same future through the map have features agreeing from some step on; the extrapolation still tells the values through the map apart.
